test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

Some bottles are pens.

All pens are tables. All tables are glasses.

**Conclusion (I):** Some glasses are bottles.

**Conclusion (II): **Some pens are glasses.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/543b3fa22b76cafc1e4e61e2f787ea01c29896b21c5e413446c0035c47077d99.png] 

Conclusion (I): Some glasses are bottles → **True** (Some bottles are pens, all pens are tables and all tables are glasses implies that some glasses are bottles).

Conclusion (II): Some pens are glasses → **True** (All pens are tables and all tables are glasses implies that some pens are definitely glasses).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow"**.
